topics.title: Space Marine update sparks fan backlash over Company Heroes changes
topics.what_is_driving_it: A long-form critique argues that the latest Space Marine update to Company Heroes has exposed wider balance and update problems in 40K, drawing a heavy comment thread.
topics.relevance_note: The video is pulling about 151k views per day with 889 comments, so the debate is active now. Covering it lets the account weigh in on balance and update quality in a format that suits short-form clips.
topics.gap_note: Discussion is concentrated in long-form commentary and comment threads, with little short-form breakdown of what actually changed and why players are split. A clear 60-second explainer or side-by-side comparison would fill that gap.

topics.title: Do Space Marines ever take baths?
topics.what_is_driving_it: A recurring lore question about how Space Marines stay clean after days sealed in power armour, answered by a short-form lore clip.
topics.relevance_note: The clip has 110k views per day and 193 comments, showing the question is popular and easy to answer in a punchy format.
topics.gap_note: The answer exists in short clips but there is little dedicated, well-sourced explainer content covering the in-universe details (power armour life support, Chapter practices). A carousel or Reel that cites specific lore would stand out.

topics.title: Freehand painting an orc entirely by hand
topics.what_is_driving_it: A short showcasing a miniature painted entirely freehand, with no decals, is drawing strong momentum from hobbyists.
topics.relevance_note: At roughly 90k views per day, freehand technique is clearly capturing interest. It translates directly into a tutorial format the account can own.
topics.gap_note: Freehand content is mostly generic miniature art, with few 40K-specific freehand breakdowns (Space Marine markings, Chaos iconography). A step-by-step freehand series on a 40K model would be a clear opening.

topics.title: Ambitious castle terrain build as a wargaming scenery showcase
topics.what_is_driving_it: A multi-day castle terrain project, now at its detailing stage, is getting a large audience for its scale and progress.
topics.relevance_note: About 87k views per day shows strong appetite for big terrain builds. Tabletop hobbyists look for ideas they can adapt to 40K battlefields.
topics.gap_note: Most large terrain builds are shown as one-off timelapses, with little guidance on making them usable for 40K. A series on building 40K-scale ruins or Imperial structures from the same kind of process would capture this audience.

topics.title: Christmas Battleforce rumours: which factions might leave shelves
topics.what_is_driving_it: Spikey Bits reports rumoured 2026 Christmas Battleforce boxes, including two Knight Lance sets and five factions possibly being discontinued.
topics.relevance_note: Battleforce releases drive purchasing decisions, and rumours with a possible discontinuation angle create urgency among collectors.

topics.title: GW's $400 terrain flop, the price cut, and which 40K armies are top now
topics.what_is_driving_it: A weekend roundup links a reported terrain set underperformance and a price cut to current competitive army rankings, sparking value debates.
topics.relevance_note: Pricing and meta are discussed together in this update, so it reaches both buyers and competitive players. It is timely because the weekend's reactions are still developing.
topics.gap_note: Price-versus-value breakdowns are mostly text articles and forum threads. A video that compares cost per point or per model across top armies, with the terrain price cut as context, would be a strong gap.

topics.title: Dawn of War 4 Space Marines faction trailer reveal
topics.what_is_driving_it: IGN's official Space Marines faction trailer for Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War 4 has launched and is drawing sustained viewing and discussion.
topics.relevance_note: The trailer has 824k views and 536 comments, with about 76k views per day, so it is a major new-release talking point. Lore fans will want to know how the Space Marine faction is portrayed.

topics.title: Horus started the Heresy by bombing his own sons
topics.what_is_driving_it: A short-form lore clip explains Horus's opening move at Isstvan III, including the deployment of loyal soldiers and the life-eater virus bombs.
topics.relevance_note: The clip is pulling about 64k views per day, and Horus Heresy lore is a steady draw for both new and returning players.
topics.gap_note: Isstvan III is a frequent subject but often covered in summary form. A detailed, sourced breakdown of the sequence of events, with a clear visual timeline, would stand out from quick takes.

topics.title: Where to find every Warhammer exclusive miniature still available
topics.what_is_driving_it: Collectors keep asking where they can still buy past Warhammer Day, Warhammer World and Commemorative Series models, and Spikey Bits has published a full list.
topics.relevance_note: This is a recurring buyer question, and the list is fresh with the 2018–2026 update. It works well as a practical carousel or Reel guide.
topics.gap_note: Most coverage is a single text list. A visual guide showing each exclusive, its release year and current availability, updated over time, would be a useful reference and a natural fit for saved posts.

examples.name: Love You to the End
examples.cinematic_angle: A deadpan single-take where a Chaos or Imperial figure is shown in a pose of romantic devotion, with the synth chorus landing as the caption reveals the ultimate devotion.

examples.name: His Angels (Epic Space Marines March)
examples.cinematic_angle: A WIP Word Bearer shot as a tracking shot across a painting bench, moving in step with the march, with the camera revealing the figure's full silhouette on the final brass hit. Keep the framing low and wide to make a single model feel like a column of warriors.

examples.name: Planet on Fire (Warhammer 40k) (feat. Pathios Productions)
examples.cinematic_angle: Pull back from a single Lion-helmed unit through the amber light to reveal the full army on the table. Let the track's swell build over the pull-back, with no cuts during the reveal.
